title: "CONA 30" zones
description: 30 km/h zones are signed "CONA 30" in Slovenia, unlike in Czechia, Slovakia or Croatia, which helps tell the Central European languages apart.

title: Kozolec hay racks
description: The kozolec, a wooden hay-drying rack, is almost exclusive to Slovenia and is common in rural areas, helping distinguish it from other Central European countries.
